description: Never asked, or reset to "Ask Next Time" in Settings. NOT a refusal: nothing here is the pilot's to fix in Settings, so currentRefusal answers null (see expect.js below) and the engine retries — the bounced watch requests permissions with the app frontmost and the system alert appears. Answering with a refusal is what left a pilot who flipped Never -> Ask Next Time on the red takeover until a SECOND trip out of the app.
